headline: Polaroid’s tiny instant camera is $72 and includes a free pack of film
summary: The second-generation Polaroid Go camera is on sale for $71.99. This deal includes a 16-photo film pack. It's the lowest price seen for this nostalgic instant camera bundle.

headline: Matt Groening lets slip that Simpsons: Hit & Run might be making a comeback
summary: Matt Groening hinted at a return for the cult classic 'The Simpsons: Hit & Run' game. He stated the original game might be 'coming back in some form.' Showrunner Matt Selman added to the speculative buzz with his reaction.

headline: Have a laugh at AI’s expense by roleplaying as a chatbot
summary: A new website, 'Your AI Slop Bores Me,' allows users to roleplay as AI chatbots. Users can submit prompts and then write AI-like responses. It's designed to humorously critique and interact with AI-generated content.

headline: Don't overlook Elektron's budget electronic music instruments
summary: Elektron's Model:Samples and Model:Cycles grooveboxes are recommended for aspiring electronic musicians. These budget-friendly instruments offer a great entry point into music production. Despite being overlooked, they provide robust features for their price.

headline: Disney Experiences Showcase at D23 2026: Everything Announced for Disney Parks, Disney Cruise Line, and More (Updating Live!)
summary: The D23 Disney Experiences Showcase is currently underway in Anaheim, California. The event promises major announcements regarding Disney Parks worldwide. Updates are also expected for the Disney Cruise Line and other experiences.

headline: Kingdom Hearts 4 Devs Say KH4 '100%' Will Not Be Delayed Past Late 2027 Launch | D23 2026
summary: Kingdom Hearts 4 developers confirmed the game will not be delayed past its late 2027 launch. Co-director Tai Yasue and creator Tetsuya Nomura made the assurance. They stated the release within that window is a '100% thing.'

headline: Kingdom Hearts 4 Gets Extended Gameplay Trailer Featuring Playable Mickey, Donald, and Goofy | D23 2026
summary: An extended gameplay trailer for Kingdom Hearts 4 debuted at D23 2026. The footage revealed playable King Mickey, Donald, and Goofy for the first time. Disney and Square Enix showcased the trailer during a deep dive panel.

headline: Star Wars: Smuggler's Gambit Lets You Keep Helping Hondo Ohnaka in Fortnite After You Leave Disneyland
summary: Fortnite introduces 'Star Wars: Smuggler's Gambit,' extending the Disneyland 'Smuggler's Run' experience. This new PvE multiplayer game allows players to continue aiding Hondo Ohnaka. Linking Epic Games and MyDisney accounts can unlock special theme park experiences.

headline: Thousands displaced by deadly Indonesia earthquake as rescue efforts continue
summary: A deadly earthquake in Indonesia has killed at least 51 people. Hundreds of homes and public buildings suffered severe damage. Rescue efforts are ongoing as thousands remain displaced.

headline: Three killed as Russia launches fresh aerial attacks across Ukraine
summary: Russia launched new aerial attacks across Ukraine, resulting in three deaths. Firefighters are battling a blaze at a market in Kyiv. Moscow also reported a warehouse was hit during the strikes.

headline: Reform proposes £50bn welfare bill cut with changes to disability payments for millions
summary: The Reform party proposes a £50 billion cut to the UK's welfare bill. This plan includes significant changes to disability payment systems. Millions could be affected by the proposed replacement for the PIP system.

headline: People who fled Stourbridge fires start to return home
summary: Residents evacuated due to fires in Stourbridge are beginning to return home. Many families are just now discovering the extent of damage to their properties. The return marks the start of assessing the impact of the blazes.
